title: Little Rock Air Force Base hosts 10th Liberty Fest - NewsBreak
text: LITTLE ROCK Ark. — Patriotic spirit and community celebration were on full display Wednesday evening as Little Rock Air Force Base hosted its 10th Annual Liberty Fest at Heritage Park. The event welcomed an estimated 3,000 attendees and featured a lineup of food, fun, live music and fireworks to honor Independence Day. Liberty Fest kicked off at 5 p.m. with a wide range of attractions for attendees of all ages. Families enjoyed inflatable obstacle courses and games, while adults competed in a spirited cornhole tournament beginning at 6 p.m. The evening’s entertainment included live performances by local artist Kate Kristine and Outlaw Apostles, culminating in a stunning fireworks display at 9 p.m. “We just have a lot here at the event for families,” said Maj. Caitlyn Williams, Commander of the 19th Force Support Squadron. “It’s a full, fun day for anyone with base access—active duty, their families, retirees and civilians. This is what we’re here for: to bring people together, to celebrate, and to make sure families have opportunities like this.” Guests also sampled food from local food trucks and sipped on beverages from the Hangar 1080 Beer Tent. Tastings from Jack Daniels and Captain Morgan. The atmosphere was one of camaraderie and appreciation for both service and community. “This is awesome,” said Kevin Seeney, Senior Enlisted Leader of Wing Staff Agencies in the 19th Comptroller Squadron. “I love having a safe place where I can bring my family, celebrate the Fourth of July, and reflect on what this country means. It’s important to step back and build relationships outside of the office. That’s what makes events like this so meaningful.” With a strong turnout and high energy throughout the evening, Seeney said Liberty Fest once again delivered a memorable and meaningful experience for the base community—one filled with laughter, music and the shared pride of service and country. The night was highlighted by a dazzling fireworks display, which lit up the skies above Little Rock AFB. Offering a powerful and beautiful conclusion to a day devoted to unity, freedom and celebration. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KARK.
